files.role: Original PMU reference source; immutable archived copy, platform adaptations listed separately

adaptation: UI selection and 17-step workflow ported; capture control adapted to registered DeviceGateway RPC with per-step manifests. PMU reuses an existing executable or prepares a verified bundle built from the fixed platform source when the default device path is missing; capability inspection makes no perf hardware availability claim.
pmu_binary_binding: The original reference and platform 1.1.0 source are archived with immutable hashes. Version 1.2.0 adds auto/all independent groups with per-event failure diagnostics and group-local denominators. Legacy single-group CLI and capability schema identifiers remain compatible. Managed bundles bind the current source, compiler and binary; when a default device executable lacks a requested multi-group mode, a verified new version is installed at a new content-addressed path, preserving existing files and saved plans. Custom device paths are inspected but never overwritten.

changes: Accept strictly parsed 10–10000 us requested periods; reject invalid decimal syntax, range and multiplication overflow before hardware setup
Add --version and --capabilities without perf_event_open; retain sampler version in measurements
Preserve normal-policy absolute clock_nanosleep; requested period is not a temporal-resolution guarantee
Add auto/all same-operation independent groups with group-local cycles/instructions and event-level open diagnostics
Preserve legacy single-group format; add grouped_long_csv and per-group scheduling, read brackets and runtime coverage
Limit multi-group sample buffers to 128 MiB and record requested/effective sampling periods
Provide base cycles/instructions fallback and retain all group opening/enable failures in metadata
